newsitem.title: USA: Morgan's Foods writes down unit assets.
newsitem.headline: Morgan's Foods writes down unit assets.

text.p: Morgan's Foods Inc said Tuesday that it wrote down the assets of East Side Mario's restaurants by $1.7 million.
During fiscal 1997 both the company and the franchisor made changes to the East Side Mario's restaurants which were expected to improve results but did not, Morgan's said.

The company said that of the $2,939,000 in asset impairment charges reported by the company in fiscal 1997, $1,239,000 represents the write off of goodwill related to the 1987 purchase of the company's St. Louis Kentucky Fried Chicken restaurants.
Earlier, Morgan's Foods reported a fourth quarter net loss of $3,784,000 or $0.21 per share against a net loss of $436,000 or $0.02 per share in the fourth quarter of 1996.
